report.summary: The supplied evidence shows a payment_intent.succeeded webhook reporting GBP 50.00 while the order records GBP 10.00 and remains pending. The webhook returned HTTP 500. These observations indicate a payment amount inconsistency and an unsuccessful webhook response, but do not establish why either occurred or whether the HTTP 500 was caused by the amount mismatch.
supportingEvidence: The order amount is 1000 pence (GBP 10.00), while the webhook amount is 5000 pence (GBP 50.00).
The webhook event is payment_intent.succeeded, but the order status is pending.
The webhook HTTP status is 500; no error details or processing logs are supplied.
recommendations: Compare the Stripe PaymentIntent ID, amount, currency, and associated order ID against the stored order and payment records.
Inspect webhook processing logs and the HTTP 500 response details to determine where processing failed.
Review order creation and amount calculation, and check whether the webhook was matched to the correct order.
Establish whether the order status was updated after this event and whether any retries or later events occurred.
